{%- comment -%}
  Fixture css-variables with a :root collision: --fixture-gap is also declared
  on :root in the fixture asset CSS (which loads later and wins), and it is not
  in the allow-list.
{%- endcomment -%}
{% style %}
  :root {
    --font-heading: 'Fixture', sans-serif;
    --card-gap: {{ settings.card_gap | default: 6 }}px;
    --fixture-gap: {{ settings.fixture_gap | default: 4 }}px;
  }
{% endstyle %}
